hardCaps.publicInvariant: A subject consumes one trial per Plan family across revisions and losing requests have no durable side effects.
Frozen Grant intervals never overlap or gap and only the newest valid lifecycle authority changes access.
Successful plus unresolved reserved refunds never exceed the frozen period charge and full-only revocation remains atomic.
Revocation versions are monotonic and every API denies stale access within two seconds.
Pool versions are gapless, active subjects are unique, capacity never oversells, and terminal Pools never revive.
Unknown responses, restart, and cross-process replay cannot create a second business effect or rewrite saved JSON.
Persisted Work remains recoverable and an expired worker lease cannot commit.
FINAL preserves V1 identities, frozen terms, UNKNOWN reservations, fences, events, Work, and replay without synthesizing Pools.

specGaps.summary: subscriptionKind is added only to the create request; Subscription response and snapshot shape remain V1.
No Pool or Seat Domain Event type is published.
Pool uniqueness per Subscription and feature is not specified.
Renewal, subject suspension, and PlanRevision retirement or edit have no public mutation seam.
Exact integer proration formula and rounding are not published.
